cold_start_ms.first_frame_note: Stamped by the app (record.first_shown.ms_from_start), a window up with its place on it, however sharp.
cold_start_ms.how: page_drawn_ms: from the action to the first `qa state` read with the reader settled and a tile on show, so the window's fades and the looks behind the page (an edited file's signatures) aren't in it; an upper bound to within one read (read_ms_worst). window_settled_ms: from the same start to `qa wait-settled` answering, which also waits for the window's animations and background looks: the app at rest, not the page.

disk_writes.note: The process's own counter, which includes the activity log's line per command here. An agent's commands are what writes that.

hand_off_gap.note: From telling the old app, through its flush and quit, the new app's start and restore, to the page drawn (p50_ms, worst_ms: the first `qa state` with the reader settled and a tile on show, which a fade or a look at an edited file's signatures doesn't hold up) and, apart, to the window at rest (window_settled_*, which waits for those too). A process launch here, from a folder on this Mac, so it doesn't include LaunchServices or Gatekeeper.

over_budget.doing_is: doing: the last thing the window's thread said it began in that run-loop pass (a control's kind, or a bridge call: scroll, select_press, select_drag, select_release, clipboard_data), empty if the pass began nothing named. A pass may do several things and only the last is named, so doing is where to look first, not proof it was the long one.

heavy.budget_note: Named exception: 415 to 450 MiB accepted by the owner, 2026-11-07.

idle.note: A window off every screen, so what a display link or a visible window adds isn't in this.

restored_tabs.note: Against `tabs.measures`' line for 1,000. A process that's just started hasn't had its caches grow.

scroll.note: The UI thread's work per step at 120 steps a second, off screen. Frames reaching a display aren't in this: a quiet run has none.

sharp_after_scroll_stops_ms.note: From `qa scroll` returning; the reads are `qa state` round trips.
